name: Soft bars with two lines
what: Soft translucent bars and two thin axes fade in on a red-washed dark page, the scale and the labels come in one after another, then two lines (a white one and a red one) rise point by point until they show your data; the chart floats a few pixels to the end.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f26 the bars and axes fade in; f9-f51 the scale labels come in bottom to top, f15-f57 the names under the bars left to right; f24-f51 the second line is drawn along the axis; f66-f130 the first line rises point by point (each point on its own S-curve); f124-f198 the second line rises point by point; the chart floats a few pixels to the end (f0-f299)
